description: Save a travel plan as a Dreamfare trip the traveler can open, edit with their crew, and book. Pass the full day-by-day plan in one call via days; stops are enriched shortly after creation (photos, map pins, booking links). Use plan_trip instead when the traveler wants Dreamfare's planner to build the days. To copy a trip, pass copyFromPublicationId (a trip from explore_trips; keeps the creator's credit) or copyFromTripId (one of the traveler's own) and no days. Before planning a destination, check list_library for the traveler's saves there and ask whether to include them (add_to_trip source=saved_places keeps their pins and links). Returns the trip and its URL; always give the traveler that URL. Returns data plus display.resultId; call display_card to show it. presentation (optional) shapes what is shown without changing the action: compact or full layout, and only the limit, ids or sections this tool advertises.

copyFromPublicationId.description: Copy a published trip (publicationId from explore_trips) into the traveler's account

copyFromTripId.description: Duplicate one of the traveler's own trips

currency.description: Trip budgeting currency; defaults to the traveler's home currency, then USD

days.description: Day-by-day plan; day 1 falls on startDate when dates are set

cost.description: Estimated cost per person, MAJOR units (120 = $120)

costCurrency.description: ISO code for cost; defaults to the trip currency

description.description: Why it's worth it, tips, context

destination.description: Flights only: arrival airport IATA code (e.g. 'LIS')

origin.description: Flights only: departure airport IATA code (e.g. 'JFK'); gives the stop a live fare search link

time.description: Start time at the destination, 24h HH:MM

title.description: Name of the place or plan, e.g. 'Senso-ji Temple'

type.description: flight | train | transport | stay | activity | food | note

layout.description: Compact cards or the full view; keeps booking, add and error actions available.

name: create_trip
title: Create a Dreamfare trip
